epics.title: Operator can browse and inspect the dead-letter queue

stories.statement: As an operator, I can list dead-lettered messages for a subscription with paging so I can see what is stuck without querying the journal directly.

acceptance_criteria.when: an operator requests the dead-letter queue for that subscription
acceptance_criteria.then: the response returns a bounded page of dead-lettered messages for that subscription

acceptance_criteria.given: a subscription has more dead-lettered messages than fit on one page
acceptance_criteria.when: an operator requests the next page using the paging information from the prior response
acceptance_criteria.then: the response returns the subsequent set of messages with no duplicates from the previous page

acceptance_criteria.given: a subscription has no dead-lettered messages
acceptance_criteria.when: an operator requests the dead-letter queue for that subscription
acceptance_criteria.then: the response returns an empty page rather than an error

stories.statement: As an operator, I can inspect a single dead-lettered message to see its payload and the reason it failed.

acceptance_criteria.given: a dead-lettered message with a known id exists
acceptance_criteria.when: an operator requests that message's detail
acceptance_criteria.then: the response includes the message's full payload and its recorded failure reason

acceptance_criteria.given: no dead-lettered message exists with the given id
acceptance_criteria.when: an operator requests that message's detail
acceptance_criteria.then: the request is rejected with a not-found response

epics.title: Operator can redrive dead-letters back onto the subscription

stories.statement: As an operator, I can redrive a selected set of dead-lettered messages back onto the subscription for another delivery attempt.

acceptance_criteria.given: an operator has selected one or more dead-lettered message ids on a subscription
acceptance_criteria.when: the operator requests a redrive of those ids

acceptance_criteria.given: a selected message id does not belong to any dead-lettered message on the subscription
acceptance_criteria.when: the operator requests a redrive including that id
acceptance_criteria.then: the request is rejected without re-enqueuing any message from it

stories.statement: As an operator, I can redrive all dead-lettered messages on a subscription back onto it for another delivery attempt.

acceptance_criteria.given: a subscription has multiple dead-lettered messages
acceptance_criteria.when: the operator requests a redrive of all dead letters on that subscription
acceptance_criteria.then: every dead-lettered message on that subscription is re-enqueued for delivery

acceptance_criteria.given: a subscription has no dead-lettered messages
acceptance_criteria.when: the operator requests a redrive of all dead letters on that subscription
acceptance_criteria.then: the request completes without enqueuing any message

stories.statement: As an operator, redriving messages is idempotent and never disturbs messages currently in-flight for delivery.

acceptance_criteria.given: a redrive request for a set of message ids has already been processed
acceptance_criteria.when: the identical redrive request is submitted again
acceptance_criteria.then: the messages are not re-enqueued a second time and no duplicate delivery attempt is created

acceptance_criteria.given: a message on the subscription is currently in-flight for delivery
acceptance_criteria.when: a redrive is issued for that subscription
acceptance_criteria.then: the in-flight delivery continues unaffected and is not duplicated or cancelled by the redrive
